Zoe: Heads-up - int4 bring-up (qint4-shrink) shows a consistent drop in top-1 recall on our short-instruction prompt slice (~4%). Small but systematic.
Ben: Which prompt bucket? tiny-instruct or ops-troubleshoot?
Zoe: tiny-instruct. Ran local eval: `./eval_harness --model qint4-shrink --prompts promptsets/tiny_instruct_mar26.json --metrics recall@1,rerank --out /tmp/qint4_shrink.json` 
Rhea: Before humans, run a quick duplicate/fingerprint pass. Last time we had paraphrase clustering causing false positives.
Zoe: doing `python tools/fingerprint_norm.py --in /tmp/qint4_shrink.json --sim 0.9` now.
(10m later)
Zoe: fingerprint report: 3 exact dup, 10 near-dup (0.88-0.95). Not enough to explain the shift.
Ben: Ok queue a micro-golden but keep it small: 60 worst diffs. We want human judgment + adversarial paraphrase checks.
Ben: @label-bot create-batch --name "qint4-shrink-60" --size 60 --golden true --owners Rhea,Zoe --priority high
label-bot: Batch qint4-shrink-60 created and assigned. ETA 8-10 hours. React :eyes: to allow senior auto-approve.
Rhea: Also spin up a 0.5% canary pinned to qint4-shrink for tiny-instruct route so we get live telemetry. Track rerank flips, user-helpful events, and token-cost.
infra-bot: Canary created: canary/qint4-shrink-0.5pct (deploy id 91011). Retention 48h. Dashboards updated.
Ben: Run a quant-sensitivity matrix: kv_cache on/off, prefill_len 0/16, kernel_mode {fast,stable}. Use the same eval harness and save artifacts.
Zoe: launched `./quant_matrix --model qint4-shrink --vars kv_cache,prefill_len,kernel_mode --out /artifacts/qint4_shrink_matrix` (job id qm-331).
Rhea: Labeling plan: blind pair senior relabel, adjudicate disagreements. Add synthetic adversarial paraphrases to each example and retest. If micro-golden pass-rate < 0.95 or entailment delta > 0.03 we block promotion.
Ben: Decision owners: Zoe + Rhea. If fail, fallback canary to previous qint4-stable. Notify #eng-ml and #eng-oncall.
Zoe: tagged promptset examples with metadata: ["qint4-investigate","tiny_instruct_2026"], provenance: eval_run:1805555555, snapshot id snap-1805555555.
Rhea: I'll run a quick BERTScore sweep on top-5 outputs to catch semantic weakening beyond rerank. Posting results to the canary dashboard.
label-bot: Human batch assignment: Rhea, Zoe. Expected returns by 2026-03-27 05:00 UTC. Alerts to #eng-ml on disagreement > 0.12.
Ben: Good. Keep thread focused on artifacts only. If anyone sees latency or cost spikes in the canary abort and tag infra. :+1:
Zoe: will update thread with golden results and quant-matrix artifacts. Thanks all. :eyes:
